PROGRAMMES.title: Primary
PROGRAMMES.text: Foundations in reading, numeracy, values and curiosity — quizzes, spell bee and early activities.

PROGRAMMES.title: High School · SSC
PROGRAMMES.text: Unit tests, half-yearly and preliminary exams, practicals and Std X board preparation.

PROGRAMMES.title: Jr. College · HSC
PROGRAMMES.text: HSC preparation with practicals, Prelim II and integrated entrance coaching.

ACADEMIC_APPROACH.title: Personal advising
ACADEMIC_APPROACH.text: Academic advisors meet students regularly to set goals, track progress and offer guidance.

ACADEMIC_APPROACH.title: Peer tutors & resident advisors
ACADEMIC_APPROACH.text: Dormitory study sessions supported by peer tutors and resident advisors.

ACADEMIC_APPROACH.title: Data-driven monitoring
ACADEMIC_APPROACH.text: Administrators use data and feedback to identify areas for improvement and apply targeted interventions.

ACADEMIC_APPROACH.title: Innovative teaching
ACADEMIC_APPROACH.text: Hands-on activities, discussion and varied methods to suit diverse learning styles.

FACILITIES.title: Robotics & AI tinkering lab
FACILITIES.text: A hub of innovation where students unlock the secrets of robotics and artificial intelligence.

FACILITIES.title: Science labs
FACILITIES.text: Specialised equipment, with goggles, lab coats and emergency equipment ready and strict safety training.

FACILITIES.title: Computer lab
FACILITIES.text: A digitised computer lab — a gateway to the future for the next generation of tech leaders.

FACILITIES.title: Digital classrooms
FACILITIES.text: A projector and AV set-up in every class, with a pre-designed library of e-materials for teachers.

FACILITIES.title: Library
FACILITIES.text: A vast collection of books and digital resources in the vintage academic block.

FACILITIES.title: Performing arts centre
FACILITIES.text: Music rooms where budding musicians, actors and artists hone their craft.

BOARDING.title: Dormitories
BOARDING.text: Fully renovated; a delicate balance between home and school so your child feels safe, happy and welcome.

BOARDING.title: Dining hall
BOARDING.text: Renovated hall for 300 diners; five meals a day with menus designed by a dietician.

BOARDING.title: Prayer hall
BOARDING.text: Call to prayer five times a day; basic Islamic education and Quran recitation are emphasised.

BOARDING.title: Sick bay
BOARDING.text: A trained nurse on campus 24/7, regular doctor visits and in-house care.

BOARDING.title: Akbar Peerbhoy Sports Stadium
BOARDING.text: The largest sports ground in town, with separate grounds for football, kabaddi, volleyball and basketball.

BOARDING.title: Green campus
BOARDING.text: Rainwater harvesting and organic gardens across 174 acres of flora and fauna.

ACTIVITIES.title: Team sports
ACTIVITIES.text: Cricket, football, hockey, volleyball, basketball, kabaddi, athletics.

ACTIVITIES.title: Fitness
ACTIVITIES.text: PT, gymnastics, yoga, open gym and a skating rink.

ACTIVITIES.title: Music & choir
ACTIVITIES.text: Music rooms and an annual musical choir.

ACTIVITIES.title: Community service
ACTIVITIES.text: Service opportunities and World NGO Day.

DAY.title: Rise & pray
DAY.text: Prayer hall, Quran recitation and breakfast.

DAY.title: Lunch & rest
DAY.text: Dietician-planned meals in the dining hall.

DAY.title: Study & wind down
DAY.text: Peer tutors and the dorm in-charge.

JOURNEY.title: Arrive & settle
JOURNEY.text: Orientation for new students, a welcome assembly and the dorm in-charge as the first point of contact.

JOURNEY.title: Build foundations
JOURNEY.text: Study habits, reading and core subjects, with peer tutors, advisors and regular unit tests.

JOURNEY.title: Explore passions
JOURNEY.text: Robotics, riding, archery, debate, pottery and sport — inter-house contests let every child shine.

JOURNEY.title: Rise to the board year
JOURNEY.text: Preliminary exams, practicals and one-to-one goal setting for Std X and XII.

JOURNEY.title: Launch
JOURNEY.text: NEET, JEE, CET, NATA and CA guidance, the Annual Day prize distribution and a farewell.

DAYPLAN.title: Wake up to a fresh day
DAYPLAN.text: The hills are cool and quiet. Dormitories stir, the call to prayer rings out and the whole house starts the day together.
points: Wake-up and morning prayer in the prayer hall
Group yoga and stretching on the lawns
Freshen up, tidy the dorm and a wholesome breakfast

subs.label: Morning classes
subs.text: Digital classrooms with a projector and AV set-up, teachers who love their subjects, labs and a library of e-materials.

subs.label: Healthy snack break
subs.text: Fifteen minutes to refuel with something light from the dietician-designed menu — and catch up with friends.

subs.label: Classes continue
subs.text: Lessons resume — discussion, hands-on activities, practicals and academic advisors checking progress.

subs.label: Lunch
subs.text: The renovated dining hall seats 300. Hygiene is paramount and meals are supervised for balance and nutrition.

subs.label: School continues
subs.text: Afternoon lessons, labs and coaching — including the NEET, JEE, CET, NATA and CA tracks.

DAYPLAN.title: Play, practise, explore
DAYPLAN.text: The golden hours belong to the outdoors: the largest sports ground in town, an archery range, horses, a skating rink and clubs for every passion.
points: Cricket, football, hockey, volleyball, basketball, kabaddi, athletics
Archery, horse riding, skating, shooting range, gardening
Robotics, pottery, music, drama and debate clubs

DAYPLAN.title: Dinner together
DAYPLAN.text: The day’s last meal — warm food, stories from the day and a settled, family feeling.
points: Evening prayer and a quiet moment

DAYPLAN.title: Study, homework & wind-down
DAYPLAN.text: Supervised study sessions in the dormitories, supported by peer tutors and resident advisors.
points: Homework and revision with peer tutors
Resident advisors and dorm in-charge on hand
Reading, reflection and getting ready for bed

DAYPLAN.title: Rest — and tomorrow begins again
DAYPLAN.text: Quiet falls over the dormitories. The dorm in-charge is on duty and a trained nurse is on campus 24/7.
points: Lights out and a good night’s sleep
Dorm in-charge on duty; nurse on campus 24/7
